findings.location: Page 1, between the affiliation list and the Abstract (body text)
findings.rule: The complete postal address and the ORCID iD of the corresponding author should be indicated on the footer of page 1.
findings.problem: The corresponding author's postal address, ORCID iD, and e-mail are placed in the main body text (immediately after the affiliations and before the Abstract) rather than in the footer of page 1 as the Instructions require.

findings.location: Tables section (end of manuscript, after References)
findings.rule: Figures and Tables should be embedded in the template file at the appropriate locations (Section 5(1) Text).
findings.problem: Both Table 1 and Table 2 are collected at the very end of the manuscript under a separate 'Tables' heading, rather than being embedded at the locations in the text where they are first cited (Table 1 in 'Network construction', Table 2 in 'Nucleotide-dependent potential').

findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: Eight of the twelve listed references ([3] Tama & Sanejouand, [5] Nishimura & Morisawa, [6] Togashi & Mikhailov, [7] Ikeguchi et al., [9] Adachi et al., [10] Ichimura et al., [11] Itoh et al., [12] Yasuda et al.) are never cited anywhere in the main text, tables, or figure legends. Only [1], [2], [4], and [8] are cited in the body. The reference list should contain only references actually cited, numbered in order of first appearance.

findings.location: Reference [11]: Itoh, H., Takahashi, A., Adachi, K., Noji, H., Yasuda, R., Yoshida, M., et al. Mechanically driven ATP synthesis by F1-ATPase. Nature (in press).
findings.rule: When the Reference has a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), it should be added by its URL.
findings.problem: Reference [11] is listed without a DOI URL. The journal's own example for this exact 'in press' reference includes 'https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212', and the DOI is resolvable via Crossref. The DOI URL is missing from the manuscript's entry.

findings.location: Reference [2]: Erzberger, J. P., Berger, J. M. … Annu. Rev. Biophys. Biomol. Struct. 35, 93-114 (2006).
findings.rule: Abbreviated Journal titles follow the Index Medicus/MEDLINE format (NLM Catalog).
findings.problem: The journal 'Annual Review of Biophysics and Biomolecular Structure' was renamed to 'Annual Review of Biophysics' effective volume 35 (2006). The correct MEDLINE abbreviation for a 2006 (vol. 35) article is 'Annu. Rev. Biophys.', not the outdated 'Annu. Rev. Biophys. Biomol. Struct.'
